title: In situ-decorated heterocomposites derived from Zn(II)-based coordination polymer for asymmetric supercapacitor applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01517G, Paper
Arif Ali, Khusboo Kumari, Anupama Joy, Fatma Parween, Mst Shubnur Sultana, Ganesh Chandra Nayak
The hetero-composite (RGMZ11) was used as an asymmetric supercapacitor that shows a diffusion-controlled mechanism. The optimized RGMZ11 device could power a multiple-color disco LED and a red LED and displayed a good discharge time.
